client.version_source: Actual wait-ready and separate ping responses.

cli.evidence_limit: The agent's source summary and original-conversation technical report identify the verified CLI.12 runner. The archive contains neither CLI bytes nor separate --version stdout or the runner path in its command log. This is not independent instrumentation of the cloud process.

device_scope: One previously prepared and paired Meizu Note 16 running Android 15, in multi-AI mode and physically connected by USB for maintenance observation; not an unplugged test.
actor: Muse actual cloud environment, reporting use of its existing approved connection.

task.scope: Recover from screen-off, calculate 36×23, verify 828 visually, return HOME and release the task.
task.input_route: Fresh accessibility trees and semantic node clicks for 3, 6, multiplication, 2, 3 and equals.

calls.count_and_timing_limit: Top-level CLI invocations, not all internal HTTP requests. The span includes gaps between calls and excludes preparation, coordination and evidence export.

fresh_observe_interval.result: Unlocked launcher, with the returned full image independently reviewed.

wake.attribution_and_timing_limit: The screen-off responses, normal observe requests and received launcher image establish this bounded recovery sequence. The later read-only power sample corroborates the awake state but does not independently establish the wake actor or exact latency. The coordinator recorded no owner or maintainer phone input during the task.
wake.scope_limit: Not a protected credential unlock, deep Doze, unplugged endurance or uninterrupted continuation of the earlier 60-minute observation.

failures_and_recovery.recovery: Status confirmed the original task was still ready. After the transition settled, a fresh observe succeeded and showed the unlocked launcher. No windows invocation is retained in this round; no stale coordinates or maintainer wake assistance were used.

renewal.evidence_limit: Explicit renew commands were used during this task. Its successful completion does not demonstrate automatic renewal without those calls.

final_status.identity_limit: Identity fields in the received records are redacted, so original-identity equality was not independently compared.
final_status.scope: HOME and release complete this task; they do not establish completion of the whole acceptance run.

evidence.retained_material: Agent-prepared archive containing 29 returned JSON records, a matching command log, a technical summary and three full JPEG observations.
evidence.evidence_limit: The received image bytes are bound to the hashes and sizes in the returned observation records. This checks consistency of the delivered evidence, not an independent recording of every cloud-side tool call or model visual input.

maintainer_intervention.during_task: Read-only power sampling; no maintainer business actions, phone wake or GUI input completed any task step.
maintainer_intervention.after_task: UI inspection and later opening the coordination app occurred after the recorded final idle status. The original images and returned records were then reviewed.
maintainer_intervention.ui_timestamp_basis: Saved read-only UI artifact filesystem modification time, not an independent request-start timestamp.

not_verified: Actual Muse/Instinct mutual exclusion and handoff.
Original-profile survival across genuine independent runtime recreation.
Automatic renewal without explicit task-renew in this Muse round.
Exact wake latency, protected credential unlock, deep Doze, unplugged endurance or autonomous continuation of the earlier hour-long observation.
Another phone's migration, independent newcomer setup or long-term unattended recovery.
release_effect: Evidence only. The recommended public APK remains code39; this result does not replace another phone's control route or declare whole-product acceptance complete.
publication_boundary: Reviewed aggregate results only. No raw screenshots, private conversation or authorization text, account details, private paths or addresses, device/connection/task identifiers, credentials or configuration contents are included.
